• `{p}callreject clear` - Clear all whitelisted numbers

mention.HELP:
*Auto Mention Reply Help*

*What is it?*
When someone mentions the bot or sudo users, the bot automatically sends a saved reply message.

*Commands:* _(Owner only)_
• `{p}mention set` - Reply to any message to set it as mention reply
• `{p}mention set <text>` - Set text as mention reply
• `{p}mention get` - View current mention reply
• `{p}mention del` - Delete mention reply

*Supported Types:*
• Text messages
• Images _(with captions)_
• Videos _(with captions)_
• Audio files
• Stickers
• Documents

*How it works:*
1. Set a mention reply using the commands above
2. When someone mentions @bot or @sudo in a message
3. Bot automatically sends the saved reply

*Examples:*
• Reply to an image and type `{p}mention set`
• `{p}mention set Hello! I'm a bot`
• `{p}mention get` - to see current reply
• `{p}mention del` - to remove reply

_Note: Media files are uploaded to cloud storage for reliability._

welcome.HELP:
*🎉 WELCOME & GOODBYE SYSTEM HELP 🎉*

*📝 BASIC COMMANDS:*
• `{p}welcome <message>` - Set welcome message
• `{p}goodbye <message>` - Set goodbye message
• `{p}welcome on/off` - Enable/disable welcome
• `{p}goodbye on/off` - Enable/disable goodbye
• `{p}welcome get` - View current welcome
• `{p}goodbye get` - View current goodbye
• `{p}welcome del` - Delete welcome message
• `{p}goodbye del` - Delete goodbye message
• `{p}welcome status` - Show all groups status (owner only)
• `{p}welcome help` - Show this detailed help

*🧪 TEST COMMANDS:*
• `{p}testwelcome` - Test current welcome message
• `{p}testgoodbye` - Test current goodbye message

*📋 AVAILABLE PLACEHOLDERS:*
• `$mention` - @mentions the user
• `$user` - User's display name
• `$group` - Group name
• `$desc` - Group description
• `$count` - Current member count
• `$pp` - User's profile picture (fallback to group pic if privacy)
• `$gpp` - Group profile picture
• `$date` - Current date
• `$time` - Current time

*💡 EXAMPLE MESSAGES:*

*Welcome Examples:*
`Hey $mention! 👋 Welcome to $group! 🎉`

`Welcome $user to our amazing community! $pp
We now have $count members! 🚀`

`🎊 $mention joined $group!
📖 Description: $desc
👥 Members: $count
📅 Joined on: $date at $time $gpp`

*Goodbye Examples:*
`Goodbye $mention! 👋 Thanks for being part of $group! 💔`

`$user left the group 😢 $pp
We now have $count members remaining.`

`📤 $mention has left $group
📅 Left on: $date at $time
💭 We'll miss you! $gpp`

*⚠️ NOTES:*
• Messages are limited to {} characters
• `$pp` and `$gpp` will send images with caption
• If user's profile pic fails, group pic is used as fallback
• Use quotes for multi-word messages
• Admin access required to set messages
• Messages work for both joins and leaves

*📝 Filter Commands:*

• `{p}filter trigger | response` - Create chat filter
• `{p}filter trigger | response | global` - Create global filter
• `{p}filter trigger | response | group` - Create group-only filter
• `{p}filter trigger | response | dm` - Create DM-only filter

filter.HELP:
*🔧 Filter System Help*

*What are filters?*
Filters are auto-reply triggers that respond to specific words or phrases automatically.

*📝 Creating Filters:*
`{p}filter hello | Hi there!`
• Creates a chat-specific filter
• When someone says "hello", bot replies "Hi there!"

*🌍 Filter Scopes:*
• `chat` - Only works in current chat
• `global` - Works in all chats (owner only)
• `group` - Works in all groups only (owner only)
• `dm` - Works in all DMs only (owner only)

*⚙️ Filter Options:*
• `exact` - Only exact word matches
• `case` - Case sensitive matching

*📋 Examples:*
`{p}filter bot | I'm here! | chat`
`{p}filter help | Contact admin | global`
`{p}filter Hello | Hi! | group | exact`
`{p}filter PASSWORD | Shh! | dm | case`

*🔧 Management:*
• `{p}filter list` - List all filters
• `{p}filter del trigger` - Delete filter
• `{p}filter toggle trigger` - Enable/disable
• `{p}filter test text` - Test matching

*💡 Tips:*
• Filters are checked for every message
• Global filters work everywhere
• Use exact match for precise triggers
• Case sensitive is useful for passwords/codes

- Command: `{p}setname <name>`
- Example: `{p}setname Raganork`
- Description: _Sets the bot's display name_

*Bot Owner:*
- Command: `{p}setowner <owner>`
- Example: `{p}setowner John`
- Description: _Sets the bot owner name_

*Bot Image:*
- Command: `{p}setimage`
- Usage: _Reply to an image with `{p}setimage`_
- Description: _Sets the bot's profile image_

*Current Format:*
_Bot info is stored as: `name;owner;imagelink`_

*Tips:*
- _Use `default` as image to use local default image_
- _Changes are saved automatically_
- _Use `{p}menu` to see the updated info_

• `{p}antilink allow domain1,domain2` - Whitelist mode

*Customization:*
• `{p}antilink message Your text` - Custom warning
• `{p}antilink reset` - Reset to default
• `{p}antilink status` - View current settings

*Detection:*
• Catches `https://example.com`
• Catches `www.example.com`
• Catches `example.com`
• Catches `example.com/path`

*Modes:*
• *WARN* - Issues warnings, kicks after limit
• *KICK* - Immediately kicks users
• *DELETE* - Only deletes the message

*2.* Pairing code: type a code on the other phone

_Reply 1 or 2, or *cancel*._

📱 Send the new bot's WhatsApp number with country code.

📷 *Scan to link the new bot* ({})

On the other phone: WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan this.
_It refreshes every ~20 seconds; the newest one is always the latest message._
hatch.CODE_INTRO:
🔑 *Pairing code for +{}*

On that phone: WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device → *Link with phone number instead*, then enter the code below. It expires in about a minute.

hatch.REMOVE_USAGE: _Send {p}hatch list, then {p}hatch remove <n> with the bot's number from the list._
hatch.NO_SUCH_BOT: _No bot with that number. Check {p}hatch list._
